question: Whom resort when that guru is absent — knower, yogin, or fruit-giver?
premises: in that absence, resort to knowledge-liberation knower
who would be able to give that fruit
inference: Differentiated resort: knower for knowledge-liberation, able yogin for enjoyment-fruit.
plain_english: In that absence, resort to the knowledge-liberation knower — in enjoyment-share, the yogin who would be able to give that fruit.
